verdict.rationale: ChatGPT ships an official Codex CLI referenced extensively in docs (running from a working directory, --cd flag, --search flag, /memories and config.toml configuration, MCP scoping via .codex/config.toml), and the llms.txt confirms 'Build with the Codex CLI, IDE extension, and cloud automation.' This gives AI-native users a genuine official CLI for agentic workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI itself (community evidence pack covers only the web/chat product, not Codex CLI specifically), and no detailed CLI command reference beyond scattered flag mentions.
